paragraphs: International gold is at $4,146 an ounce, the rupee at ₹95.05 to the dollar, and the Indian jeweller board median at ₹14,806/g for 24K.
What the world's gold news is about today: US interest rates (9 headlines), The US dollar (6 headlines), Investment flows (ETFs) (3 headlines), Inflation (2 headlines).

US interest rates. Gold pays no interest, so expectations of lower US rates tend to support it and higher rates tend to weigh on it. In the news: Gold Slips as Treasury Yields Hold Firm, Fed Path Keeps Bullion Boxed In (BigGo Finance); Gold Prices Rise Above $4,200 in Futures Trading as Fed Rate Hike Expectations Ease (Yahoo Finance).

The US dollar. Gold is priced in dollars: a stronger dollar usually pushes it down, a weaker one lifts it. In the news: October 20 Financial Morning Brief: Gold prices pressured by stronger dollar; markets await policy guidance. Russian diesel has not yet entered the market, while oil prices hit a one-month high. (富途牛牛); Gold prices pressured by a strong dollar; oil hits one-month high amid geopolitical tensions (KuCoin).

Investment flows (ETFs). Money moving into or out of gold funds shows what investors are doing with their own cash. In the news: Why Is the Gold Price Falling Even as ETF Investors and Central Banks Pile In? (Morningstar); Forget GLD. Investors Sent $500 Million to the Cheaper SPDR Gold Fund (24/7 Wall St.).
